verdict.rationale: Postmark authenticates API calls with a per-server Server API Token. Servers can be created via API, and a POSTMARK_API_TEST token exists for non-sending use. Together these imply an agent could be isolated to its own server-scoped token, but the evidence never describes fine-grained permission scopes. missing for 10: documented permission scopes or read-only/send-only token types, per-token restrictions or expiry, token issuance/rotation docs, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.
